0612Database and network design and administration

Baserow on AgentEnv (REA)

earakely-scale/BaserowEnv-REA

Answer factual questions about a seeded Baserow instance and make small edits through 30 API tools in a state-backed simulation.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • tool-calling retrieval and write evals
  • MCP-style app simulations

Reward

How it is scored
Mixed
Signal
Pass or fail

Retrieval tasks score 1 if the response contains the recorded value; write tasks check the environment state afterwards.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

agent-env hf run earakely-scale/BaserowEnv-REA --bundle baserow --task smoke          # Docker, no model
agent-env hf run earakely-scale/BaserowEnv-REA --bundle baserow --eval baserow-retrieval --model openai/gpt-oss-120b:groq
agent-env hf run earakely-scale/BaserowEnv-REA --bundle baserow --eval baserow-writes --model openai/gpt-oss-120b:groq

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download earakely-scale/BaserowEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir BaserowEnv-REA

Needs: Docker; a model endpoint for evals.
